author: Zintenka
body:
Stop making rules that are contradictory to making people believe in you. Admins, please read this. This is very important.

The way in which demotions and denials have been handled have been excessively done horribly.

Denials
I don't think you understand the way applications work. For someone to be accepted/denied, there has to be a group vote about the applicant. Just because I denied your application doesn't mean that I have the evidence. Also, we're not obligated to provide evidence for every denial.

Excuse me? What? Why are denials handled in this manner? What made any of you think that this was a good idea? So you're basically denying this person's application because you don't want them in the staff team.

Plain and simple, let's not kid ourselves please.

If you don't have any evidence of them doing what they're doing then why are they being punished for it? If this was implemented in handling punishments this server would be an empty shell.

In my opinion if you want people to take you seriously and to not fear you then you ARE obligated to provide evidence otherwise your point is null and void. The person already debunked the claims made against themselves and yet you're denying them still.

This isn't a proper denial, this means that you clearly hold some biased feelings towards them and I seriously suggest that someone else handles these things.

I'm pretty sure that I told you that even though the comments may have been out of context, using vulgar language has a bad impression on you regardless and it would only lower your chances of getting accepted.

It is said that as long as the swearing isn't excessive and directed then it's allowed. You're clearly contradicting this rule; you need to re-read the rules of the server.

Staff forgetting to respond to important messages about applications.

Why are you handling these things if you know you're going to forget? I can understand if you are busy but why are you forgetting important stuff like these if you are a high-ranking staff member?

Again, I don't think you understand how applications work. Even if you have proven some points wrong, we can't simply just remove the tag. It was based on a group vote and we stick by that, our decision in the end was final.

So even though you have no evidence you not only are doing this because you're a biased staff member who should be demoted (Not directing at anyone) but there are more of you and you guys basically went on a witchhunt against one person. 

Great Staff - Community relations and transparency. Really great stuff. So great that many people are starting to trust you guys more - WRONG. 

I feel that these rules are really counter-productive to Staff - Community relations. Common sense would tell anyone, "Yeah, don't make those rules...".

What is this? The Soviet Union before 1991? This isn't an Authoritarian server, if someone wants an answer to their reason for being denied then they deserve an answer as a fellow human being.

Stop giving generic responses to denials and acceptances.

Even if someone is accepted, give a genuine human response to them. They synthesis with a human better than a copy-pasta created by a machine or a lazy person.

Mic auto denial?

Unsure whether this thing is real or not, some are saying this is true whilst others are saying that it's not. If it is real why? Not everyone has a tree that grows money in their pots or backyard, stop insinuating or assuming that people do.

You may suggest that there are mics that are cheap but again, where do I get 5 dollars? I can't steal otherwise I'll go to prison, I'd feel guilty bothering my siblings who have jobs over something as minute and petty as this. 

Demotions

I am unsure of how Eteh responded to Admins and staff overall but from what he said in his topic he never cursed or sweared at you lot. His tone may have been aggressive when he was putting forth the criticism but that's understandable when someone is genuinely pissed off.

At least he didn't curse anyone out or was talking anyone down. Why was he demoted if he did neither of these? And don't give me that response, "We aren't entitled to answer."

Given that you guys are in possession of power to ban a person or demote a person I'd say that you ARE entitled to it otherwise you're a dictator.

You aren't a regular user anymore, you're a person who holds a lot of permissions and those permissions need to be kept in check. I understood this when I was staff, why don't you people follow this example?

I don't hold any grudges against anyone on the staff team, not even Michael because me and him made up and we're now more or less people who can talk to each other normally. We're cordial and we get along now.

It's just that I and many other community members are very disappointed in the staff team and we don't trust you guys anymore. There are good people within you guys but they know themselves and I know them... some of them... I'm sure you know who you yourself are.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
This application structure is the same it has been for years. Every 3 months this is the structure we used. I don't know why this is all of a sudden become a problem. I only changed one thing and that was to ensure less biased occured. 

The rules of the server are different to the criteria of the moderating staff. Yes it says that in the rules, but they aren't the moderating criteria. 

No sugar coating it. Most application periods the seniors usually have trouble keeing on top of it, purely because people apply faster than we can get votes and comments down. No excuses, I know and we are trying our best.

We can give you reasons but we aren't obligated to give you evidence.

We aren't giving the old copy and paste response. We are actually putting quite a lot in the responses.

Let's say I was denied with the reason of two words, toxicity and immaturity. Well firstly I'd be a bit depressed, because I was denied, yet grateful for not getting the 'not up to senior staff standards' shit, and instead actual reasons.
